    Welcome to AMTZ

    AMTZ is India’s premier medical technology park with Common Manufacturing Facilities & Common Scientific Facilities that include specialized laboratories, warehousing, and testing centers such as the Center for Electromagnetic Compatibility and Safety Testing, Center for Biomaterial Testing, Center for 3-D Printing, Centers for Lasers, MRI Super Conducting Magnets, Gamma Irradiation Centre, Mold & Machining Centre, and many other industrial service centers.


    In the nation’s battle against the pandemic, Andhra Pradesh MedTech Zone contributed by producing over 100 ventilators, 500 oxygen concentrators, and 1 million RT PCR kits every day. Many innovations from Andhra Pradesh Medical Technology Zone such as mobile container hospitals, mobile RTPCR vehicles and mobile oxygen plants were sent even to the remotest parts of the country. Built in a record time of 342 days, Andhra Pradesh MedTech Zone showcases modern India as a leader in the medical technology global stage.


    Andhra Pradesh Medical Technology Zone is one of world’s largest medical technology manufacturing cluster with over 100 companies working on research, development and production of life saving medical devices.

    What They say

    Shri Nitin Gadkari

    Union Minister of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Minister for Road Transport & Highways and Minister of Shipping.

    Shri Nitin Gadkari

    “COVID-19 have amplified the country’s disproportionate import dependence for medical devices, with as much as 80 per cent coming from outside. An indigenisation movement with an eye on improving productivity as well as upgrading quality backed with cutting edge innovation can pull the country out of this dependency trap paving the way for self-sufficiency. Our goal to become self-reliant can be accomplished by adopting the AMTZ model, not just in medical devices sector but also in other strategic areas too.”

    Shri Piyush Goyal

    Minister of Railways and Minister of Commerce & Industry, GOI

    "Fulfilling the supply needs for the critical medical equipment for the nation"

    With Covid-19 outbreak, the country was totally dependent on import for COVID diagnostic kits for testing its citizens. AMTZ stepped in and was able to fulfil the need to a very large extend. Close to 60 percent of the first 5 lakh tests conducted in India was done with kits that had AMTZ’s name on it. Impressed by the response, Shri Piyush Goyal was generous in his praise for AMTZ and the people behind it serving the national cause.

    Shri Piyush Goyal

    Minister of Railways and Minister of Commerce & Industry, GOI

    Smt Smriti Irani

    Former Union Minister of Textiles and Minister of Women & Child Development

    Smt Smriti Irani

    Former Union Minister of Textiles and Minister of Women & Child Development.

    Before World Health Organization (WHO) spoke of a global shortage of personal protective equipment (PPE), India had no PPE coveralls suitable for COVID 19 in the country. Though hospitals had routine supply for testing H1N1 & HIV, nobody in the world had anticipated such an outbreak. The entire requirement was being met through imports. It is never easy to produce and meet the humungous requirement when the country is put under a lockdown, workers worried about their safety, shortage in raw materials and transport a logistical nightmare. But AMTZ did!
